airflow:dagaccessentity.description: Filters access by the DAG sub-resource that the caller specifies in the request, such as RUN, CODE, or TASK_LOGS

airflow:resourceaction.description: Filters access by the action on the Airflow resource that the caller specifies in the request, such as GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, or LIST

airflow:resourceid.description: Filters access by the Airflow resource identifier that the caller specifies in the request, such as a DAG ID or connection ID

airflow:resourcetype.description: Filters access by the Airflow resource type that the caller specifies in the request, such as DAG, Connection, Variable, or Pool

airflow:teamnames.description: Filters access by the team names that the caller specifies in the request. AWS does not verify that the caller is a member of these teams

aws:requesttag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by the presence of tag key-value pairs in the request

aws:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by tag key-value pairs attached to the resource

aws:tagkeys.description: Filters access by tag keys in the request
